lines: 1. Kabamv kathui ai phaeng zau guangc nga.
Nzianmei guang Poubaomei ta hou na;
Lily munpuang pui ramc khou tei,

Mikdui keina tam nimei hei,
Bui nung rui riu dat nicho?
Jordan pang khou riu pui kan khou,

2. Hou khang ning e nzian mei nun ta,

3. Kagan kathui ai ningtan mak ge,
Nzian meita tamna kaplak ni cho?
Adi sii cho kandih mei nun ,
Mikdui phui lou pui bam mak kandih khou.
4. Ntampui bam ana bam khou hei ,
Zingmei lim rui gumliam lou bam khou hei
Ti gaan lou o tingkao riw rui
Zian mei chamv panc guay tam dikho salam
